hook: Brew Phials that ripen in your hand, then pour one huge dose through a lens onto your carries.
loop: Moths give you Phials; cast one now or hold it to Steep
Held Phials grow each turn; casts raise your Recipe count
Merge to a giant Phial, or Echo casts across your board

growth.line: Phials gain +1 N a turn while held; spell scaling makes casts on big units multiply.

feel.early: Small Phials, cast for tempo or held to ripen
feel.mid: Hand fills; pick holding and merging or casting everything
feel.late: One cast fans out into several Echoes on big units

stars.why: A clogged hand merges into one Phial that passes the cap
Weak cast on a small lens becomes scaled Echoes behind it
Every big cast leaves a leftover Phial for either build

card_short.u01: When played: get a small Phial.
card_short.u02: Grows in fights for each Phial you hold.
card_short.u03: Lets you sell Phials for gold.
card_short.u04: Spell cast on it buffs both neighbours flat.
card_short.u05: Gives a Phial, then your Phials Steep twice.
card_short.u06: End of Turn: get a small Phial.
card_short.u07: Full hand: new Phials merge into your biggest, past the cap.
card_short.u08: Random unit grows for each spell cast last turn.
card_short.u09: Fight buff on your weakest unit from your biggest Phial.
card_short.u10: Spell cast on it Echoes onto units behind.
card_short.u11: Every fifth Recipe spell Echoes onto its target's neighbours.
card_short.u12: Phials Steep an extra time, and up to 7.
card_short.u13: Cheaper shop spells; buying one gives a matching Phial.
card_short.u14: Start of Turn: a Phial sized by your Recipe.
card_short.u15: Deals your Phials' total N in damage, up to thrice a fight.
card_short.u16: Casting a Phial gives a half-size Phial back.
card_short.u17: Can't be targeted; Echoes every spell you cast elsewhere.
card_short.u18: Every Phial cast Echoes again on the same unit.
card_short.u19: A Phial of N 8+ Echoes across its whole row.
card_short.x01: Hand spell: +N/+N permanently, scaled; Steeps while held.

builds.name: Big Batch
builds.line: Hold and merge into an N 8+ Phial for Elder and Burnet

builds.name: Long Recipe
builds.line: Cast everything; Shipton and Alchymist push Carbonaria's Phials bigger

builds.name: Concentrate
builds.line: Cast on small lenses so untargetable Dame Pavonia grows from Echoes

liked: Cocoon Spinner turns a clogged hand into the route past the cap
The Spectacle and Shipton: aiming, placement and leftovers that feed both builds
worries: Watch: Dame Pavonia's scaled Echoes compound every turn with no ceiling
Watch: Burnet with a merged Phial 15-20 can hit 60+ a fight
changed: Alchymist's counted Echoes now set off The Old Lady; Pavonia can take Echoes
Pestle Grinder now gives a Phial, so it does something early
Golden Herald Steeps to 8, a second route to Elder's N 8
verdict: Settled at fun 7, distinct 6.3; ranked third of three as hardest to read. For players who love planning big combo turns.
